display.title: The enlarged festival portrait
display.body: They enlarged Sakiko's photograph for the festival. Someone painted a smile over her mouth. She asked them to take it down.

recording.title: Festival recording transcript
recording.body:
“The front-door key is in the rehearsal room. On the chair beside the mirror.”

“And Sakiko?”

“I thought you were going back.”

[Knocking.]

“Turn it off.”

letter.title: Sakiko’s undelivered letter
letter.body: Could I help in the library next year? I don't want my photograph used again. Please ask them to take it down.

notice.title: School notice
notice.body:
18 October 1999

We regret to inform families of the death of student Sakiko following an accident in a restricted scenery storage room.

Festival activities are suspended. Please direct inquiries to the school office.
